name: power sled pull
description: A drag-style move where you pull a loaded sled toward you with a rope or strap, walking backward. It trains the back, arms and legs together.
instructions: Attach a rope or strap to a loaded sled and grip it with both hands.
Face the sled, hinge slightly and set your feet.
Pull the rope hand over hand while walking backward.
Keep your chest up and your back straight.
Drive through your legs as the sled comes toward you.
Stop when the sled reaches you and reset.
